stem.text: Formal norms are written behavioral rules. Which invented example is a formal norm?

options.label: A
options.text: A resident's private conviction about kindness

options.label: B
options.text: A written laboratory rule requiring visitors to sign in

options.label: D
options.text: An unwritten custom of waving to neighbors

key_explanation.text: Option B is a written laboratory rule requiring visitors to sign in. It is an explicit written expectation for behavior, the defining feature of a formal norm.

strongest_distractor.text: D describes an unwritten custom, an informal rather than formal norm. A is a belief or conviction, while C is a value or ideal; neither is an explicit written behavioral rule.
